title: Scoped obstruction: one free P112 rectangle cannot improve one coordinate COPY
body:
Adding a zero-cost correction on odd entries escapes the all-pairs decoder premise, but mixing it with one original P112 coordinate term still cannot improve COPY cost. This scoped result proves the sharp whole-decoder floor **64** for arbitrary complex corrections supported on any zero-pairing rectangle and arbitrary GL(2,C) factor changes involving exactly one original term. For a nonzero correction with two active coordinate products, each replacement has rank at least six. At unchanged width/normalization, the COPY power bill also cannot improve.

Only `research/p112-free-rectangle-mixing/` is added: written proof, exact source pins, reproducible receipt, task/overlap card, registered replay and a separately implemented finite-premise checker. No new kappa, physical supplier or selected-frontier change is claimed. Coupled mixing of two or more original terms remains open; complete gathering, frame, restoration, hosting, precision and analytic obligations remain explicit.

Validation on macOS arm64 / CPython 3.12.14 and 3.14.7:
- `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-free-rectangle-mixing` passes.
- All 896 slice spans, all 100,352 cross pairings and 6,272 stored basis rows agree across implementations; eight exact Q(i) fixtures and 15 built-in controls pass. Two additional CLI receipt corruptions are rejected.
- A minimal relocated export passes both commands under `-I -O -S -B`, without modifying files. Selected-record integrity and staged whitespace checks pass.
- No selected cold replay, hosted CI result, proof-assistant or independent human review is claimed.

Base/current-main-at-entry: `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`. Card `complex-masked-decoder`, refined scope; chooser nonce `4db6ec8657b781ead81a5f0b421eff29`. Final overlap completely paginated 816 open PRs and 66 discussion records; TASK.json retains exact nearby heads and search limits. Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1316.

Pending masked/root-star/all-pairs work is distinguished in README/TASK and is not a theorem dependency. Apache-2.0. Prepared by Arham Tahir with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematics, implementation, verification and writing.
